name: workflow-run-path-with-a-run-part-at-its-edges
description: Held text names files through a run path whose part follows a directory whose name starts with @, which is a path and not a scoped package because the part goes on with it, and through a run path that ends in a doubled separator, which names a directory as one separator does. So @tools/build-web.mjs and scripts/sub/index.js are held and nothing they export is reported, while @tools/other.mjs, which no step writes, and scripts/lint.js, which a path naming a directory does not name, are reported.
